highlights: Yesido DH16 is a smart and versatile emergency lighting solution for both home and outdoor use. With stretchable LED panels, you get wide and even lighting at any time, even during power outages.
The rechargeable design makes the lamp a reliable choice for backup, camping or as a work light wherever you need extra light.
Compact size and energy-efficient LEDs provide long-lasting, bright lighting right where you need it.
Product Type: Extendable LED Emergency Light
